== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (Japanese)|You Will Go To The Dagobah System]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160326796/jlTtsC8kfEiGI9TLR-Svvg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 93899917.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7cce2b0e0911eb640e2ff0e990030139a250b7fc794c220683bdd5af2008071e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
